static_functions.name: stringify
static_functions.description: Returns a string representing value encoded in JSON
static_functions.description_details: Functions and a table that references itself or one of its parent tables (cyclic table) cannot be encoded, they become null. Metatables are not encoded, only the table's own fields

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: the table that will become JSON

examples.title: Stringifies a Lua table
examples.content: local encoded_value = JSON.stringify({ 1, 2, 3, { x = 10, y = Vector(1, 2, 3) }, "he" })

static_functions.name: parse
static_functions.description: Returns a value representing the decoded JSON string

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: the JSON that will become a table

examples.title: Parses a JSON string into a Lua table
